title: Rattlesnakes By Mail: A Field Guide to the Crawlers of the Web
description: Rattlesnakes By Mail is a public record of documented and observed behaviour of AI crawlers, covering entities from OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Microsoft and Apple. Each claim carries a vendor quote, a date and a source URL. This dataset is a nightly export of the site's public tables: entities, claims, changes, observation_daily, questions, notes and mcp_calls_daily, exported as JSON and CSV.
